io.milvus.bulkwriter.connect

Class GcpMetadataServerCredentialsProvider

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.milvus.bulkwriter.connect.GcpMetadataServerCredentialsProvider
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    io.minio.credentials.Provider

    public class GcpMetadataServerCredentialsProvider
extends Object
implements io.minio.credentials.Provider
    A minio Provider that fetches OAuth2 access tokens from the GCE metadata server, for workloads running on GCP with a service-account-attached identity (GKE workload identity, GCE service account).

    The GCS XML API authenticates with an Authorization: Bearer header instead of request signing, so the access token is carried in Credentials.sessionToken() (matching the established convention of passing the GCS bearer token as the session token); accessKey/secretKey hold a sentinel value and are never used.

    Tokens are cached and refetched shortly before the server-reported expiry, so a long-running writer never sends an expired token. If a refetch fails while the cached token is still valid, the cached token is served until it truly expires; the cached fast path is lock-free, since fetch() is invoked per storage request.
